limits: Known-document internal holdout only, no independent source.
No new oral negatives in dev/test: four all train by provenance groups.
Floors and skirtings have no new held-out support.
Known 27/16 synthetic diagnostic is historical and already known.
Field normalization is lexical with scoped identities: exactness is strict, not an expert semantic similarity score.
RAM is process peak including imports, not marginal model RAM.
Latency measured sequentially on local CPU; ablations reuse rules timing.
Prior technical failed runs preserved; final annotation revision driven by source QA, no score-based parameter tuning.

manifest.split_policy: group hash plus deterministic rare-label train coverage; no prediction-based assignment

phenomena.method: Structural reference predicates plus documented literal indicators; indicators are coverage diagnostics, not an automatic gold adjudicator. Spoken/synthetic cases authored individually.

privacy: Aggregate counts only. No original literals, prices, individual predictions, source item IDs or weights.
